author: madhva
summary: Madhva's verse work supplementing his Brahma Sutra commentary, developing its arguments and responding to rival schools at length.
whyRead: The Anuvyakhyana is where Madhva's arguments against Advaita and other schools are worked out in detail. It is a text for advanced study, often read with Jayatirtha's later commentary on it.
questions: How does Dvaita defend the reality of difference?
How does Madhva answer Advaita's arguments?

keyTeachings.title: Expanding the commentary
keyTeachings.text: It elaborates the interpretation of the Brahma Sutras presented briefly in Madhva's Bhashya.

keyTeachings.title: Defence of difference
keyTeachings.text: It argues that difference is given in valid perception and cannot be dismissed as illusion.

keyTeachings.title: Engagement with rivals
keyTeachings.text: It engages Advaita and other schools in extended argument.

structure.label: Verse work in four chapters, following the Brahma Sutras

relatedTexts.note: A principal target of its arguments
